written.headline: Meta’s $25 billion share sale oversubscribed fivefold as it seeks $98 billion for AI
written.summary: Meta Platforms’ upsized $25 billion share offering attracted demand about five times the available shares, with the 15 largest investors taking roughly 70% of the allocation. The sale is part of a plan to raise up to $98 billion for AI infrastructure.

written.headline: NVIDIA releases Metatron-v1 ONNX models for G1 robot control on Hugging Face
written.summary: NVIDIA published two ONNX files for its Metatron G1 scene/recovery policy on Hugging Face. The files support interactive humanoid control and locomotion in browser applications but require matching observation and control interfaces.

written.headline: Experts influenced by AI agents’ positions even when they think they’re independent
written.summary: Ethan Mollick notes that experts using AI agents are swayed by the AI’s stance, even if they believe they remain impartial. He advises deliberate timing of AI involvement when independent judgment matters.

written.headline: Anthropic expands GSA partnership, offering 40% discount on Claude to government agencies
written.summary: Anthropic announced a new agreement with the U.S. General Services Administration that gives federal, state, local, tribal and territorial agencies a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government and the Claude API. The discount is projected to save the government about $1 billion and removes minimum‑spend commitments.
